QA reasoning/prompt failure.cause: The prompt treated an explicit evidence-calibration requirement as refutation, converting genuinely unresolved assertions from indeterminate to defective.
The reviewer double-counted an evidence-mapping symptom after identifying, or instead of identifying, the substantive root defect.
The exact-class precedence was underspecified for internal inconsistency, omitted conflict, population qualification, and governing-source provenance.
The reviewer elevated an incidental grammatical actor outside the requested quantity into a material unsupported attribution.

repository-authority limitation.cause: The supplied authority intentionally cannot resolve the asserted fact; correct gauge behavior is indeterminate, not additional retrieval.

v2_iterations.mcp_access_disposition: No MCP change justified. Every missed case supplied the governing authority, exact records, and stable locators needed for the reference judgment.

material_changes.change: authority ledger -> claim/obligation ledger -> deterministic verification -> three-state epistemic decision -> exact-class precedence

Make truth status dominant over evidence-calibration requirements, require minimal non-overlapping root-cause findings, tighten materiality, and add general class precedence for whole-answer inconsistency, omitted conflict, population qualification, and draft-versus-governing-source errors.
